title: Glow Baby Log Status Mix
dataSources: Baby feeds (`baby:feed`), baby sleep (`baby:sleep`), diaper changes (`diaper:change`), chore completions (`chore:completion`), allowance ledger (`allowance:ledger`), family calendar (`family:calendar`), growth measurements (`growth:measurement`), screen time (`screentime:usage`).
app: Baby-tracking app exports (Huckleberry/Baby Daybook), chore and allowance boards, shared family calendars, screen-time reports, and growth logs via Splunk HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=glowbaby:log
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(log_status,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the Glow Baby log feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `log_status` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It finds the overall mood of your Glow Baby log feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
